name: Galaxy S7

images.credit: GadgetsGuy (collage by GalaxyOptimus), CC BY 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: 2G GSM/GPRS/EDGE – 850, 900, 1800, 1900 MHz, 2G CDMA2000, CDMA 1xRTT – 800, 850, 1900 MHz, 3G TD-SCDMA – 1900, 2000 MHz, 3G UMTS/HSDPA/HSUPA/HSPA+ – 850, 900, Advanced Wireless Services, AWS (1700), 1900, 2000, 2100 MHz, 4G LTE (telecommunication), LTE – Bands 1–5, 7–8, 12–13, 17–20, 25–26, 28–30, 38–41

Body.Dimensions: S7:, 142.4 mm H, 69.6 mm W, 7.9 mm D, S7 Edge:, 150.9 mm H, 72.6 mm W, 7.7 mm D, S7 Active:, 148.8 mm H, 74.9 mm W, 9.9 mm D
Body.Weight: S7: 152 g, S7 Edge: 157 g, S7 Active: 184.8 g

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 6.0.1 "Marshmallow" with TouchWiz Hero UX, Current: Android 8.0 "Oreo" with Samsung Experience 9.0
Platform.Chipset: Global: Samsung Exynos 8890, USA and China: Qualcomm Snapdragon 820
Platform.CPU: Exynos: Octa-core (4x2.3 GHz Mongoose & 4x1.6 GHz Cortex-A53), Snapdragon: Quad-core (2x2.15 GHz Kryo & 2x1.6 GHz Kryo)

Display.Display: S7: 5.1 in 227 ppcm (577 ppi), S7 Edge: 5.5 in 210 ppcm (534 ppi), S7 Active: 5.1 in 227 ppcm (576 ppi), Super AMOLED, Quad HD Super AMOLED 2560×1440 pixel resolution (16:9 Display aspect ratio, aspect ratio), (all PenTile matrix family#PenTile RGBG, Diamond PenTile)

Cameras.Rear camera: Samsung ISOCELL S5K2L1 or Sony Exmor RS IMX260 12 MP (4032×3024), 1.4 μm pixel size, f/1.7 aperture, 2160p(4K) at 30fps(limited to 10 m since Android 7 update), 1440p(QHD) at 30fps, 1080p at 30/60fps, 720p at 30/60fps, real-time slow motion video recording at 720p@240fps
Cameras.Front camera: Samsung S5K4E6 5 MP (2592×1464), f/1.7 aperture, 1440p/1080p/720p video recording

Battery.Battery: All internal:, S7: 3,000 mAh, 3.85 V, S7 Edge: 3,600 mAh, S7 Active: 4,000 mAh
Battery.Charging: Wired: Qualcomm Quick Charge 2.0 up to 15 W, Wireless: Qi and AirFuel Inductive wireless charging up to 7.5 W
